Enum Class VisionTelemetryField

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<VisionTelemetryField>
yall.telemetry.VisionTelemetryField
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<VisionTelemetryField>, Constable
public enum VisionTelemetryField extends Enum<VisionTelemetryField>
One group of values a camera can publish, and the lowest verbosity that publishes it.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ACCEPTED_POSES
    acceptedPoses: the pose estimates the filter accepted in the last update.
    CONNECTED
    connected: whether the camera is sending data.
    FILTER_STATS
    stats/...: pose filter counts (accepted, rejected, rejected by each check, acceptance rate) and the spread of the accepted poses (mean, standard deviations, sample count).
    HAS_TARGETS
    hasTargets: whether the newest frame has targets.
    LATENCY
    latencyMillis: the newest frame's latency.
    REJECTED_POSES
    rejectedPoses: the pose estimates the filter rejected in the last update.
    REJECTION_REASON
    rejectionReason: why the filter last rejected an estimate.
    TARGET_COUNT
    targetCount: how many targets the newest frame has.
    TARGETS
    targets/...: every target's ID, yaw, pitch and area.
